newsitem.title: USA: Magnum to buy oil/gas properties for $143.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Magnum to buy oil/gas properties for $143.5 mln.

text.p: Magnum Petroleum Inc said Friday it has executed a definitive agreement with subsidiaries of Burlington Resources Inc, to acquire certain oil and gas properties located in West Texas and Southeast New Mexico -- the Permian Basin Properties -- for $143.5 million, effective January 1.
Magnum said the transaction would increase pro-forma annual revenues to more than $50 million.

The company also said it has made a performance deposit of $10 million with Burlington until closing, which it expects on or before April 30. Funding of the transaction, said the company, will come from bank loans and a private placement of securities.

There are a total of 25 field areas in West Texas and 21 field areas in Southeast New Mexico containing 3,100 oil and gas completions, said the company, and the gross mineral acreage holdings included in this acquisition total 114,810 acres of which 82,175 are net mineral acres.
